add.title: LGBTQ rights in Haiti - Wikipedia
add.summary: Thin for the prison-housing axis: the fetched article (HTTP 200) documents Haiti's legal framework - same-sex conduct legal since 1791, no legal gender-identity recognition, no anti-discrimination protections, and a June 2017 Senate bill penalising same-sex marriage with up to three years' imprisonment - plus documented harassment of transgender people in post-earthquake camps. It contains no prison-placement practice: no birth-sex-vs-identity housing rule, no trans special units, and no solitary/segregation practice for trans prisoners; no usable placement finding.
